parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminal offence, same-sex conduct decriminalised, and no documented police, border or organised targeting of trans visitors. Societal attitudes are recorded as broadly neutral and among the region's more tolerant, with 85% opposing violence, though surveys are dated and mainly sexual-orientation framed, and family ostracisation and resident discrimination are documented. Offsetting this, no working visitor-facing remedy is shown: hate/incitement provisions have no recorded prosecutions, and discrimination protections are absent and employment protection was repealed in 2024 — largely a resident/climate signal, not a visitor exposure. Absence of legal gender recognition is likewise resident-facing. Border, facility, custody, and care practice are undocumented open questions, not known exposures. This sits above documented recurring visitor harm, but below jurisdictions with demonstrated acceptance plus effective recourse.
